design_identity.core_philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Dark Mode Mandatory. Content is King.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@400;500;700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

usage_rules: NO GRADIENTS for backgrounds. Use solid matte colors.
Use 'accent' (#991B1B) VERY sparingly. Only for 'New' badges or critical notifications.
Primary action buttons should be White (foreground) with Black text.
Secondary actions should be subtle Ghost or Outline buttons.

grid_modes.series_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 md:gap-8
grid_modes.hero_section: relative h-[70vh] w-full flex items-end justify-start p-8 md:p-16 overflow-hidden

news_card.style: bg-transparent border-b border-border/40 pb-8 rounded-none hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors duration-300 group
elements: Image: Aspect Ratio 16:9, grayscale-0 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500
Meta: Date & Category in uppercase mono font text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2
Excerpt: hidden md:block text-muted-foreground mt-2 line-clamp-2

series_card.style: relative aspect-[2/3] overflow-hidden rounded-sm bg-secondary group cursor-pointer
elements: Overlay: Gradient from bottom-black/80 to transparent (visible on hover)
Info: Absolute bottom-4 left-4 z-10 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity

feed_switcher.item: text-lg font-medium pb-4 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:text-white transition-all data-[state=active]:border-white data-[state=active]:text-white text-muted-foreground

navigation.style: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-border/40 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use bright/neon colors. Stick to the 'Quiet Editorial' palette.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings. If not available, use a strong condensed sans-serif.
Ensure high contrast for text (White on Black, or Light Grey on Dark Grey).
News Cards must be 'Horizontal' (Image Left, Text Right) to mimic editorial lists.
Implement 'Feed Switcher' using Tabs logic but styled as a minimal underline list.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install 'Barlow Condensed' and 'Manrope'. 2. Set up the tailwind.config.js with the provided colors. 3. Create the 'NewsCard' and 'SeriesCard' components first. 4. Build the 'Home' page with the 'Feed Switcher'. 5. Ensure the 'Notification Center' is a subtle bell icon in the header.
